messages:
alex_w: Kicking off terraform run to add 5 g5 nodepools in eu-west-1. Will follow with helm sync. tagging @priya @sean for heads-up.

alex_w (code):
```
terraform apply -var='count=5' ./modules/nodepool
...
Error: RequestLimitExceeded: ENI API throttle
```

alex_w: Immediately hit helm-controller reconcile errors and duplicate-ownerrefs when helm tries to create static pods. Pods stuck in Pending because of ENI/IP exhaustion and CNI plugin attaching delays.

priya: Hmm, creating multiple nodepools concurrently + CNI cold start is our usual anti-pattern. Can we pause the argocd app for the runtime namespace before the next terraform batch?

sean: Agree. Also the helm-controller leader election is flapping when controllers try to adopt existing resources. That causes deploy-bot traffic-shift step to abort. We should serialise nodepool creation and add a reconcilation pause.

jordan: Cost FYI 4b8 4b8 4b8 - provisioning 5 g5s will push committed spend above the monthly forecast for eu-west-1. Do we have burst capacity or should we convert some to spot? ENI quota alarm at 90%.

infra-bot: automation: terraform-runner 2048001300 started. parallelism=3 -> advised to retry with parallelism=1. resources_requested=5 nodepools.

deploy-bot: automation: canary shift attempted -> FAILED. reason="helm-controller: multiple leader election locks / resource adoption conflict". logs=/var/log/helm-controller/helm-2048001310.log

priya: Mitigation plan: 1) Pause argocd app: kubectl -n argocd patch application runtime-app -p '{"spec":{"paused":true}}' --type=merge 2) Re-run terraform with parallelism=1 and sleep 60s between creations. 3) Add preflight script to check ENI quota before each create.

sean: Add to that: annotate autoscaler + kube-system pods with scheduling.kubernetes.io/avoid-disruptions=true so the autoscaler doesn't aggressively evict infra pods during bootstrap. Also increase argocd leader-election-config leaseDuration to reduce flapping during churn.

alex_w: Done: paused app and restarted terraform with parallelism=1. First nodepool created, nodes registered, CNI warmed, helm-controller successfully completed release reconcile for runtime. Rolling the remaining 4 with 90s delays.

jordan: Observed ENI usage drop after node1 registered; pods started scheduling. Cost alert suppressed for now but we need quota planning. Opening a ticket to request ENI quota bump + a reserved capacity analysis.

priya: Follow-ups: create RFC for gated GitOps (pre-create checks, explicit pause API), provider-side quota check script in terraform-runner, playbook for 'traffic-shift into newly provisioned nodepools' that includes leader-election pauses. I'll own the RFC.

alex_w: Also adding a small change to terraform: resource "aws_network_interface" creation backoff from 2s to 10s to reduce API throttles when multiple attachments happen.

oncall: Keep me looped if autoscaler thrashes. I'll watch cluster-proxy and kubelet logs for the next 2 hours. :eyes:

priya: Filing postmortem and tagging cost ops / platform-sre. Short-term: avoid bulk parallel nodepool creates in eu-west-1 until quota request lands.

alex_w: Thanks team. Learned: parallel creates + active gitops + helm adoption = recipe for leader election chaos. Going to update our runbooks. :thumbsup:
